findings.suggested_fix: Ask whether opening the list from the tile clears the current search (as A-02 did for status) or keeps it, and record the answer and any mismatch on REQ-7.
findings.text: REQ-7 keeps the list's current search, but REQ-5 requires the list to show exactly the patients counted, and the glossary says a tile links to the list it counts. A kept search would hide counted patients, the same clash A-02 settled for status; no question was asked for search.

findings.text: REQ-3 statement says patients are counted 'whether they are now Active and Inactive'; a patient is one or the other, so 'or' is meant (the body line already says 'Active or Inactive').

questions.text: When staff open the patient list from the New patients tile, should a search already typed on the list be cleared so the list shows exactly the counted patients, or kept as ticket AC6 says?

rubric_items.reason: All nine acceptance criteria map to REQ-1..REQ-15; AC6 split into REQ-6, REQ-7, REQ-13, REQ-14, REQ-15; API filter design is out of scope with a reason.
Previous F-1 resolved: REQ-13 now states only the no-status-filter opening and the later status filter is REQ-15. Each REQ holds one checkable behaviour.
Every REQ cites the ticket or a user answer. REQ-15 reads 'keeps its current status filter' as 'can still use it and it narrows', an inference marked known on ticket L24 alone.
The status-filter tension was asked (A-02) with a mismatch. The same tension for the kept current search (REQ-7) against 'exactly the patients it counts' (REQ-5, glossary Dashboard) was not raised.
Q-01 and Q-02 were precise with a proposed default and a real alternative, both answered; the search-retention question is missing.
Plain words and consistent glossary terms; REQ-3 statement says 'whether they are now Active and Inactive' where 'or' is meant.
